recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5286 unless a work group separately wants to revisit alias rendering outside the current ImagingStudy source.
issue_request: FHIR-5286 was a Published / Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Imaging WG ballot issue asking to clarify the ImagingStudy.clinicalInformation alias. The accepted resolution added AdditionalPatientHistory and used camel-case DICOM-style alias text, while comments also identified Manifest and XDS-I summary as aliases of ImagingObjectSelection rather than ImagingStudy.
initial_application: Commit a51afaf7a9b18b211c1b998e3903993967cc3984 explicitly tagged [#5286] and changed the old ImagingStudy spreadsheet alias from Admitting Diagnoses Description to AdmittingDiagnosesDescription; AdditionalPatientHistory. Later ImagingStudy history removed the root Manifest/XDS-I summary alias row and then removed the old clinicalInformation element.
additional_context: The current build scope lists imagingstudy=ImagingStudy in source/fhir.ini. The active StructureDefinition has no ImagingStudy.clinicalInformation element and no root-level aliases; remaining aliases are DICOM-style camel-case terms on current child elements. FHIR-5542 separately handled the broader alias-rendering concern, and no contrary Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current active source already satisfies the seed issue and editing retired history or removed-resource artifacts would not affect the current specification.
